name: Better Late Than Single
description: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Fresh from their makeover, 10 hopefuls arrive at Eternal Singles' Resort. Their first meeting is clumsy and full of nerves — can they find first love here?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The singles try their first dates — but is this even dating? Flirting fails, and chaos follows. That night, a bold new arrival shakes up the resort.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The day after random 15-minute dates, misread signals cause confusion in the women's room. Next, the women choose — and true feelings start to show.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A dashing new single joins the group, and one-on-one dates continue. Though hearts drift, one single finally gets the meeting they've been longing for.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Competition for one single heats up before date selection. While others face date drama and love triangles, Kim Yeo-myung finally confesses her feelings.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tangled feelings and tears fill the resort's wildest night yet. After many missed chances, Noh Jae-yun gathers the courage to reveal what's in his heart.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A surefire couple faces doubt, and a well-meaning lie causes tension. Meanwhile, Jae-yun pulls someone aside for a surprising heart-to-heart.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jae-yun tries to fix his mistake, while a once-certain couple starts to fall apart. With nerves high, one man comes to recognize his true feelings.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The singles get their first-ever overnight date, causing shock for those left behind. But back at the resort, a careless action stirs up new trouble.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: It's the last day at the resort. Who will leave with their first love — and who will walk away still searching?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Meet the new eternal singles, from a silver fox-turned-stud game developer to a K-pop superfan. Soon, they pair up for a mission based on shared palates.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Surprise singles shake up the village. Someone feels an intense pull after less than a day together. Later, the men arm wrestle to win the first date.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As the singles reveal their jobs, one quietly worries his appeal might change. The other single is still all over the place about how he feels.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While three men fall for the same woman, the once wishy-washy single finally makes up his mind. A fate-struck straight shooter starts meeting others.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: On two‑on‑one dates, the women's top picks are revealed for the first time. As a solid pair starts to crack, the men grow jealous and fired up.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tensions rise as the singles finally express their feelings without holding back — but a careless remark threatens to ruin the mood and blow things up.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Shocking Sparks House choices stun the village — leaving some singles reeling. A whirlwind fifth night of emotions leaves the singles on edge.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Hyuk-joon wrestles with mixed feelings over the gift he received. That night, Su-ji comes to understand her feelings during an amusement park group date.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Singles get one last chance to date the partner of their choice — some finally lay their true feelings on the line and discover a new spark.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The last chances to solidify connections force singles to be bold — or forever hold their peace. Who will leave the village no longer an eternal single?
